description: The assessment ratio (county value / sale price) for recorded home sales in a Twin Cities ZIP, city or county: the share of sold homes the county valued above their sale price, the median ratio, and how it ranks against the rest of the metro, plus the IAAO uniformity measures by county and the gap between cheaper and dearer homes. Use for 'does Ramsey County over-assess homes', 'are assessments too high in 55104', 'how accurate are property assessments in Roseville'. Covers houses and townhouses in Ramsey, Anoka, Dakota, Scott and Washington counties and the City of Minneapolis.

area.description: A ZIP (55104), a city (Roseville, Saint Paul) or a county (Ramsey)

name: assessment_ratio_by_area
title: Does the county over-assess homes here? Assessment ratio by ZIP, city or county (Twin Cities)
